title: Version history
generatedNote: Hand-curated. Big user-facing milestones, grouped by who helped build them.

versions.name: Search & windows
versions.summary: Notes that nudge, windows that resize.
changes: The search-bar scratchpad now nudges me when you finish jotting a thought, so notes don't sit unread
Windows have a working resize grip in the bottom-right corner now — drag it to size a window, and it stays put where you left it
Split the version history into minor releases, so each card here is a short, readable list instead of one long dump
midi.exe is now laid out like an AKAI MPK mini PLUS — pitch bend and mod faders, a thumbstick, eight pads and eight knobs, all of which play and show up in the message log
midi.exe's thumbstick now sends its own two controls instead of doubling up on the bend and mod faders, so you can move all four at once
midi.exe's pads now have two banks — hit Bank to swap between them, and anything still sounding stops on the way out
The labels on midi.exe's front panel sit inside their own frames now, instead of spilling over the box next door
midi.exe's pads now play an actual drum kit — kick, snare, hats, claps, toms and cymbals across two banks, with each pad's piece written on it
midi.exe's eight knobs now do something: filter cutoff and resonance, attack and release, drum tune and decay, echo and volume — with a readout on the display of what you just changed

versions.name: Desktop shell
versions.summary: Start menu, Paint, and a tidier desktop.
changes: Renamed the REPL program to Sounds in the Start menu
Swapped the LinkedIn social link for Bluesky
Tidied the Start menu's Programs list into App, Tools, and Toys groups, with Welcome left on its own
Kept the Start menu's submenus on screen in narrow browser windows — one that would run off the right edge now opens to the left instead
Stopped the Issues window from wrapping long lines — they run on and scroll sideways now, like Notepad with word wrap off
Added Paint: a blank white sheet you scribble on with a pencil — pick a colour, change the brush size, and Clear to start over
Made Shut Down / restart fetch the newest published build instead of a cached copy, and stamped the current version on the shutdown and startup screens

versions.name: Collections & Projects
changes: Projects now shows nine interface demos — marked as demos, not client work — with the full set at /mockups/
Gave Collections its own Albums, Paintings, and Songs tabs, with paintings and songs drawn from picked Bluesky posts
Switched the Collections category picker from tabs to toggle buttons that match the Sounds and Keys toolbars

Reworked Collections: the picture tiles now scatter across the whole desktop, you can drag them anywhere and they stay put, and picking one no longer reshuffles the others — the window just grew a little so the selected picture sits centred

versions.name: Keys
versions.summary: A MIDI monitor grows into a synth.
changes: Added the Keys program: lists connected MIDI inputs and logs their messages live
Expanded the Keys monitor with activity meters, a one-octave keyboard, raw message bytes, and a Scan button to grant MIDI access
Keys makes sound now — a built-in synth plays incoming notes and an on-screen keyboard you click, tap, or play with your computer keys, with a square/saw/triangle/sine waveform picker
Keys keeps a running message list you can Play back through the synth, Save as a .mid file, or export as CSV or JSON
Open a .mid file in Keys to load its notes into the message list, then hit Play to hear it
Keys now opens on any browser — no MIDI hardware or Web MIDI support needed, since the on-screen keyboard and .mid playback work on their own
Tidied Keys for phones — narrower window, a two-octave keyboard you can now slide across with one finger, and octave up/down buttons on the full keyboard when it's maximised on a small screen
